title: Folk-Lore and Legends: Scandinavian
summary: "Folk-Lore and Legends: Scandinavian" by Charles John Tibbitts is a collection of folk tales and legends written in the late 19th century. The collection includes classic tales such as "The Wonderful Plough" and "How a Lad Stole the Giant's Treasure," offering readers a glimpse into the enchanting world of Scandinavian traditions and beliefs. The introduction presents various captivating tales, starting with a farmer who encounters a trapped dwarf and gains a magical plough, followed by a peasant boy who outsmarts giants to win treasures and the heart of a princess. These stories set the stage for a captivating exploration of heroism, cleverness, and the interplay between the human and supernatural worlds, engaging readers with their fantastical elements and moral lessons.
